channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.
item.description: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The map notes now say Parcel E2 has its own Assessor lot (Block 4116, Lot 008, per Port Item 12B) and no longer claim the site was never subdivided or that there may be two different 'E2' parcels. The 2042 completion milestone is a soft placeholder (the 2017 Phase 3 outside date, tolled by down market delay), and the claim that the Phase 1 schedule had lapsed was removed. The Item 11A milestones are dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, 'since 2022' was dropped, the Board of Supervisors' Oct 31 and Nov 14, 2017 votes are stated correctly, and the design is credited to Kennerly only as a 2021 SF YIMBY report. The earlier entry for the Parcel E2 lease agenda item now reads 'enter into' rather than 'negotiate'.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) describes proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 7, 2026)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
